items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Louis Prima was working at Jimmy Ryan's

ctx.x: When they found out they could get a draw. Those were hard times, there was -- we weren't working below 110th Street at this period of time. It wasn't until '39, '37 that the Spirits of Rhythm were working at the Street and Louis Prima was working at Jimmy Ryan's and Eddie Condon was working at Gallaher's and this was strictly a white --
Right, the beginning of 52nd Street was a white thing.
